children.zh-CN: 替换按键提示的内容，写在标签内。传了 children 就不渲染默认的按键提示，快捷键仍然有效。
children.en-US: Replaces the key hint, written inside the tag. With children the default key hint is not rendered and the hot keys stay active.

content.zh-CN: 显示的按键文字，缺省显示 hotKeys。
content.en-US: Key labels to show. Defaults to hotKeys.

getListenerTarget.zh-CN: 返回监听 keydown 的元素；缺省或返回 null、undefined 时使用 document.body。
getListenerTarget.en-US: Returns the element that listens for keydown. When omitted, or when it returns null or undefined, document.body is used.

hotKeys.zh-CN: 快捷键组合：任意个修饰键加一个普通键，取值参考 KeyboardEvent.key。组合不合法时在挂载或 hotKeys 变化时抛错。
hotKeys.en-US: The key combination: any number of modifiers plus one other key, as KeyboardEvent.key values. An invalid combination throws on mount or when hotKeys changes.

onHotKey.zh-CN: 按下完整的快捷键组合时的回调，参数为原生 KeyboardEvent。
onHotKey.en-US: Called when the full key combination is pressed, with the native KeyboardEvent.

preventDefault.zh-CN: 是否阻止快捷键的默认行为。
preventDefault.en-US: Whether the default behavior of the key combination is prevented.
